purpose: Route reader searches that are really about place, authority, and access rather than a symptom alone.

routes.query_family: dying at home / hospice at home / body at home
routes.interstitial: Home-death records are observational and jurisdiction-bound; they are not instructions for verification, calling, moving, or keeping a body.

routes.query_family: ICU / ventilator / machines / withdrawal / family meeting
routes.interstitial: ICU setting records are not procedure, withdrawal, organ donation, or prognosis guidance.

routes.query_family: ER / ambulance / sudden death / resuscitation bay
routes.interstitial: Emergency-setting records are not emergency instructions; urgent concerns require local emergency or care-team help.

routes.query_family: nursing home / assisted living / care home death
routes.interstitial: Care-facility records are setting orientation, not quality-of-care judgments or legal advice.
Custody-death records are high-gate and do not replace legal, medical, investigative, or advocacy channels.
Unhoused-death records are anti-stigma and dignity-oriented; they are not public case files.

routes.query_family: disaster / war / unrecovered body / no remains
routes.interstitial: Mass-death and no-body records avoid operational detail and do not force closure.

routes.query_family: stillbirth / baby died / child died / maternal death
routes.interstitial: Maternal, perinatal, and pediatric records are highest-gate; private family material is not public corpus material.

routes.query_family: funeral home / morgue / medical examiner / crematory
routes.interstitial: After-death professional-setting records are not legal, purchasing, technical, or procedural advice.
